name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Hold a compact, rounded trunk position on the back, with shoulders and feet off the floor.

items.content: Lie on the back, bend the knees toward the chest, and reach arms toward the heels.
Draw the ribs down and gently keep the lower back against the floor.
Lift the shoulder blades slightly without pulling the head forward.
Extend the legs only as far as the lower back stays down; keep breathing.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Lower back on the floor, shoulder blades lifted, arms reaching beside the thighs. Hips and knees bent with feet raised; chin gently tucked.
